questions.question: Explain how to read the time when the hour hand is between 6 and 7 and the minute hand points at the 3.
questions.expected_answer: The hour is 6, because the hour hand has passed 6 but not reached 7. The minute hand on the 3 means 3 times 5, which is 15 minutes. The time is 6:15, a quarter past six.

questions.question: Explain what a.m. and p.m. mean and write the time Nomsa goes to bed, half past eight at night, in the 12-hour way.
questions.expected_answer: a.m. means from midnight to just before midday, and p.m. means from midday to just before midnight. Half past eight at night is 8:30 p.m.

questions.question: Change 1:30 p.m. and 8:30 p.m. into the 24-hour way, and change 15:45 back into the 12-hour way.
questions.expected_answer: Add 12 to the afternoon and evening hours: 1:30 p.m. is 13:30 and 8:30 p.m. is 20:30. For 15:45, take away 12 from 15 to get 3, so it is 3:45 p.m.
